# cofide_connect_cloud_account (Resource)

Manages a Cofide Connect cloud account. A cloud account represents a cloud provider account (e.g. an AWS account) linked to a Cofide organization and is the target for workload discovery.

The `aws.lambda_discovery_config`, `aws.agent_core_discovery_config`, and `suppressed` fields may either be managed inline here, or independently via the `cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config`, `cofide_connect_aws_agent_core_discovery_config`, and `cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config` resources respectively. This is useful because a cloud account's existence may be controlled by automatic discovery rather than Terraform: omit these fields here to leave them under external management. Do not manage the same field both inline and via a standalone resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# ------ Example: default ------
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "org_id" {
  description = "The ID of the Cofide organization."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-org-id"
}

variable "cloud_organization_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud organization this account belongs to."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-org-id"
}

variable "name" {
  description = "The name of the cloud account."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-account"
}

variable "aws_account_id" {
  description = "The 12-digit AWS account ID."
  type        = string
  default     = "123456789012"
}


# This cloud account only manages identity/name and does not set discovery
# config or suppression inline, leaving them under external management (e.g.
# automatic discovery, or the standalone cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config,
# cofide_connect_aws_agent_core_discovery_config, and
# cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config resources).
resource "cofide_connect_cloud_account" "example" {
  org_id                = var.org_id
  cloud_organization_id = var.cloud_organization_id
  name                  = var.name

  aws = {
    account_id = var.aws_account_id
  }
}


output "cloud_account_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud account."
  value       = cofide_connect_cloud_account.example.id
}


# ------ Example: with_inline_discovery ------
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cofide = {
      source  = "cofide/cofide"
      version = "~> 0.9.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "cofide" {}


variable "org_id" {
  description = "The ID of the Cofide organization."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-org-id"
}

variable "name" {
  description = "The name of the cloud account."
  type        = string
  default     = "example-cloud-account"
}

variable "aws_account_id" {
  description = "The 12-digit AWS account ID."
  type        = string
  default     = "123456789012"
}

variable "discovery_role_arn" {
  description = "The ARN of the IAM role to assume for discovery."
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/cofide-discovery"
}


# This cloud account manages its Lambda discovery config and suppression
# state inline. Do not also manage these fields with the standalone
# cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config or
# cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config resources for the same account.
resource "cofide_connect_cloud_account" "example" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = var.name

  aws = {
    account_id = var.aws_account_id

    lambda_discovery_config = {
      audience          = "spiffe://example.org/lambda-discovery"
      regions           = ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
      discovery_enabled = true

      role_chain = [
        {
          iam_role_arn = var.discovery_role_arn
        }
      ]
    }
  }

  suppressed = false
}


output "cloud_account_id" {
  description = "The ID of the cloud account."
  value       = cofide_connect_cloud_account.example.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS-specific configuration for the cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `name` (String) The name of the cloud account.
- `org_id` (String) The ID of the Cofide organization this cloud account belongs to. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `cloud_organization_id` (String) The ID of the cloud organization this cloud account belongs to, if any. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `managed_by_discovery` (Boolean) When true, the existence of this cloud account in Connect is managed by the discovery mechanism: if a subsequent discovery run for the parent cloud organization does not find this account, it is deleted. Set to false to manually manage the existence of this resource outside of cloud organization level discovery.
- `suppressed` (Boolean) When true, discovery is suspended for this account and existing discovered resources are hidden from findings. May instead be managed with the standalone `cofide_connect_cloud_account_suppression_config` resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of resource creation.
- `id` (String) The ID of the cloud account.
- `last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last resource update.

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `account_id` (String) The 12-digit AWS account ID. Cannot be changed after creation.

Optional:

- `agent_core_discovery_config` (Attributes) Configuration for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime discovery. May instead be managed with the standalone `cofide_connect_aws_agent_core_discovery_config` resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--agent_core_discovery_config))
- `lambda_discovery_config` (Attributes) Configuration for Lambda function discovery. May instead be managed with the standalone `cofide_connect_aws_lambda_discovery_config` resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--lambda_discovery_config))

<a id="nestedatt--aws--agent_core_discovery_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws.agent_core_discovery_config`

Required:

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call.
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume when discovering AgentCore runtimes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--agent_core_discovery_config--role_chain))

Optional:

- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this config.
- `regions` (List of String) AWS regions to discover resources in.

Read-Only:

- `last_successful_discovery` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery run.
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).
- `status_last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last status update.

<a id="nestedatt--aws--agent_core_discovery_config--role_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws.agent_core_discovery_config.role_chain`

Required:

- `iam_role_arn` (String) ARN of the IAM role to assume.

Optional:

- `external_id` (String) Optional external ID for confused-deputy protection.



<a id="nestedatt--aws--lambda_discovery_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws.lambda_discovery_config`

Required:

- `audience` (String) Audience value for the initial SPIFFE JWT-based assume role call.
- `role_chain` (Attributes List) Ordered chain of IAM roles to assume when discovering Lambda functions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws--lambda_discovery_config--role_chain))

Optional:

- `discovery_enabled` (Boolean) Whether discovery is enabled for this config.
- `regions` (List of String) AWS regions to discover resources in.

Read-Only:

- `last_successful_discovery` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last successful discovery run.
- `status` (String) The current status of cloud resource discovery (e.g. `DISCOVERING`, `ERROR`).
- `status_last_updated_at` (String) The timestamp (RFC3339) of the last status update.
